queries: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount * 1.0) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_diff, g.avg_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_vs_overall FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Snapshots with NULL corpeventprx form one group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together) and count as one of the event-type groups in the overall average.

The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-group average differences. Groups whose average difference is missing are ignored. Per-group averages skip rows where inholdpct or instownpct is NULL, because the difference is then NULL.

responses.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analysts, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_analysts, g.avg_diff, g.avg_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_vs_overall FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The per-row difference is inholdpct - instownpct. Rows where either value is missing have a missing difference and are ignored in that group's average. A group whose differences are all missing has a NULL average and is excluded from the overall average, but it is still returned.

Snapshots with a NULL corpeventprx form one group, because GROUP BY puts NULLs together. The overall average is the plain unweighted mean of the group averages, with the NULL group counted as one of them.

responses.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS event_type, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.event_type, g.avg_analyst_count, g.avg_diff, g.avg_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_vs_overall FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The plain overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-group average differences. The NULL-event group counts as one group, and groups whose average difference is missing are ignored.
A row's difference is computed only when both inholdpct and instownpct are present. Rows missing either value are left out of that average, but they still count toward the average analyst count.
